items.title: Macron says Paris suburb shooting that killed one person was terrorist and racist act
items.brief: A gunman killed one person and wounded five others, including a 12-year-old girl, in a shooting in a Paris suburb that French President Emmanuel Macron described as a “terrorist and racist” attack.

items.title: At least 7 people killed in unprecedented shooting at church in Jordan
items.brief: At least seven people were killed and another 40 injured after gunmen opened fire on a church in Jordan’s southern Karak province, in an unprecedented attack that has left the nation stunned.
